whoWeAre.heroSubtitle: Student-founded, shaped by lived experience, and built to make international study feel less distant
whoWeAre.imageAlt: A calm and professional DARB working environment

founder.fact: An International Business student, an international student, and learning German firsthand
founder.title: I started DARB at 22, while living the journey myself
founder.bodyOne: I was studying International Business as an international student, and I also had to learn German. I knew what it felt like to enter a new system with questions that were not always answered in one place
founder.bodyTwo: DARB began from that experience. Not from the idea that one person has every answer, but from the belief that students deserve someone who understands the distance between finding information and knowing what to do with it

story.title: From one student experience to a shared purpose
story.body: Our story is still being written, but its beginning is simple: understand the journey personally, recognize what is missing, and build a better bridge for the student who comes next

chapters.title: Living the experience
chapters.body: Studying internationally and learning German made the unfamiliar parts of the journey visible from a student's point of view

chapters.title: Recognizing the gap
chapters.body: Information existed, but understanding how it connected — and what to do next — was often the harder part

chapters.title: Building DARB
chapters.body: DARB grew from the idea that students should meet the international-study journey with context, a human connection, and a clearer sense of direction

direction.title: Why we are building DARB
direction.missionTitle: Make international study feel understandable and less distant
direction.missionBody: We connect information with human guidance, so students can approach the journey with context instead of facing every question alone
direction.visionTitle: A trusted bridge between students and what comes next
direction.visionBody: We want DARB to be a place where students feel known, can understand the people supporting them, and can approach institutions and decisions with greater clarity

team.title: A young team that stays close to the student experience
team.body: DARB is built by people who understand different parts of the international-study journey and bring those perspectives together. We are growing carefully, with the aim that visitors know who they are speaking with and what each person is responsible for
team.personal: As our team grows, this space will introduce each member with a real portrait, direct contact details, and a clear description of their role

closing.title: Trust starts by knowing who is on the other side
closing.body: This page is our introduction, not a sales pitch. If you are considering studying abroad and still deciding who to trust, speak with us, ask direct questions, and get to know the people behind DARB
